jobs.description: Retired by the takeover of the 부속지번 lane (root ADR-0564 §6-4): the Spark producer of gold.parcel_sub_parcels, whose Spark job is gone; gold_parcel_sub_parcels_versions_build builds the lane's table gold.parcel_sub_parcels_versions and by_pnu_parcel_sub_parcels_bake bakes that. Listed off, never to run again, because a release may not drop a job the running release has enabled (scripts/deploy/foundation-release.sh activation, scripts/guard/a-release-keeps-the-jobs-it-switches-off.sh); the entry goes in a later change, once a release that lists it off is live.
jobs.memory_measured: no memory peak logged 2026-10-18..11-08 (no cap, so no memory accounting); sized as the script foundation-gold-panel-rebuild.service runs (307M measured, 57 runs); Spark runs in its own capped container; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Not enabled and never to run again: the lane was taken over (root ADR-0564 §6-4), so no run of it is left to measure.

jobs.disabled_reason: Off for good: the lane was taken over on 2026-11-24 (root ADR-0564 §6-4) and gold_parcel_sub_parcels_versions_build is its producer. Nothing turns it on; the entry is deleted once a release that lists it off is live (the release activation refuses a candidate that drops an enabled job).

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: 부속지번 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0399, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-sub-parcels → publisher build-parcel-sub-parcels-versions): gold.parcel_sub_parcels_versions from the current 부속지번 rows (silver.building_register_sub_parcel), read from both of a link's parcels, computed by DuckDB inside the publisher and appended as the keys whose digest changed (a removal marker for a key that left), each commit one version_seq. The lane's table since its takeover (the Spark gold_parcel_sub_parcels_rebuild and gold.parcel_sub_parcels's writes ended with it; takeover_equal was equal in 시도 41 on run 20261123T141640Z): it reads every input at its head. Nothing to do when its inputs, the served parcel edition and its code are the base commit's. A change of the code change table, the served edition or the code rebuilds every PNU; otherwise both ends of every link that differs between the two reads and the parcels that entered or left the served edition. It starts no Spark; it holds two slots of the host's heavy-work pool, as the lanes' other publisher builds (root ADR-0567: the pool moves with the orchestration, not the engine). by_pnu_parcel_sub_parcels_bake bakes its commits.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261122T195940Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-sub-parcels (2026-11-22 19:59-20:02Z, its first build: every served parcel's 9,942,819 link rows in 17 시도, 1,639,313 rows committed in 192 s), the publisher's cgroup memory peak in its run log 3,200,585,728 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (duckdb_parquet_stage MEMORY_SHARE), so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak. The run fit: no timeout, under MemoryMax

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: the first shadow build holds every key. It reads the served parcel edition's PNUs (about 40 million) and the current 부속지번 rows (silver.building_register_sub_parcel: 5,566,401 rows of every vintage, Trino 2026-11-22), and folds both directions in one statement for the about 1.64 million PNUs gold.parcel_sub_parcels holds. Lane 1 (gold_parcel_register_masters_versions_build) folded 583,561 rows over the same served edition in 30 s (2026-11-22 02:03Z). About 600 s with the read, inside the 60-minute limit. Later runs rebuild the changed PNUs only.

jobs.description: Reflect each new commit of gold.parcel_sub_parcels_versions (the own-producer 부속지번 kind, root ADR-0399) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-sub-parcels), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9), exactly as the ownership bake. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2). Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_sub_parcels_versions_build commits; the first bake after the takeover is a full generation with a content check against the served one (root ADR-0564 §6-5), and at 10:55 as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the ownership bake's bound (root ADR-0138).

assets.title: 필지 부속지번 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지에 걸친 대장을 양쪽에서 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0399): 이 필지가 대지인 대장이 함께 걸친 다른 필지, 다른 필지가 대지인 대장이 이 필지에도 걸친 것. 항목마다 대장(관리건축물대장PK·대장종류명)과 상대 필지(PNU·지번), 방향마다 100건까지와 전체 수. 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-sub-parcels)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓는다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 양 끝의 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다. 넘겨받기(루트 ADR-0564 §6-4) 뒤로는 쓰지 않고 남긴다(쌓기만 한다): 레인은 gold.parcel_sub_parcels_versions 를 굽는다.

assets.title: 필지 부속지번 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: 루트 ADR-0399 의 부속지번 by-PNU 표를 판을 쌓는 표로(루트 ADR-0564 §1·§2): gold.parcel_sub_parcels 의 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더해 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙인다. 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 계산하고 발행기가 추가 커밋으로 붙인다. 레인이 굽는 표다(넘겨받기, 루트 ADR-0564 §6-4): 입력의 머리로 짓는다.

assets.title: 필지 부속지번 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_sub_parcels_versions 의 현재 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/sub-parcels/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0399). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.

dependencies.description: 현재 부속지번 행을 양 끝(대장 대지·부속 필지)에서 읽어 두 PNU 를 서빙 법정동 코드로 다시 매기고 서빙 필지판의 PNU 에 문서로 접는다(DuckDB, 루트 ADR-0399). 두 읽기 사이에 달라진 연결의 양 끝 PNU 만 다시 짓는다.
서빙 필지판의 PNU 가 문서의 전체 집합이다(루트 ADR-0292). 들고 난 필지만 다시 짓는다.
재편으로 바뀐 코드의 행을 양 끝 모두 서빙 코드로 읽는다(루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 모든 PNU 를 다시 짓는다.
레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다(넘겨받기, 루트 ADR-0564 §6-4). 넘겨받은 뒤 첫 굽기는 서빙 세대와 내용을 견주는 전량 세대다(§6-5).
